name: Notification Agent
description: Security notification agent that converts vulnerability findings into per-owner per-vulnerability emails and manages security communications.

skills.name: Notify System Owners
skills.description: Ability to send security notifications: consumes natural language security reports, groups findings by owner and vulnerabilities, drafts concise emails per owner per vulnerability (systems/packages, actions), and persists them.
examples: There's a vulnerability GHSA-7x3m-9w8k-2p4q in the Maven package org.apache.struts:struts2-core version 2.5.30. The vulnerable range spans from 2.5.0 to 2.5.32. The affected systems are payment-gateway-api, user-auth-service, and admin-dashboard-backend, all owned by Sarah Chen. Send the notification to sarah.chen@company.com.
